title: Hamlet: Shakespeare's Great Tragedy
text: Hamlet, Prince of Denmark is a tragedy written by William Shakespeare, believed to have been written around 1600. It centers on Prince Hamlet's quest for revenge against his uncle Claudius, who has murdered Hamlet's father (the king), seized the throne, and married Hamlet's mother Gertrude. The play is renowned for its soliloquies, most famously 'To be, or not to be, that is the question,' in which Hamlet contemplates existence and suicide. Hamlet explores themes of revenge, corruption, mortality, and madness. It is the longest of Shakespeare's plays and is considered the most influential literary work ever written. Hamlet has been performed continuously since its creation.
